title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：resistance　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 resistance 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the clerk ① met the resistance that no applicant in the office would have noted, and he said the meeting was the whole of the month. The ② resistance, meaning the opposition itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; resistance, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sort of resistance in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ resistance at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Resistance, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the clerk said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the resistance was the whole of the matter, meaning the will and not the opposition. The ⑥ resistance, meaning the will and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; resistance, he said, is either something you meet or the only word that means both opposition and a will. He said the will is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ resistance had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ resistance of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of noting; resistance, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ resistance I remember is the resistance noted in the file, which closed in 1964 and is still noted as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Resistance, my mother said in 1966, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all resistance, she said, is a will that has agreed to look like opposition. She said the will was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 抵抗；阻力（指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 抵抗；阻力（指那股抵抗本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：meet the resistance 遇到这一股抵抗
D. n. 抵抗；阻力（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 抵抗之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的抵抗之事）
F. n. 抵抗；阻力（指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一股）
G. n. 抵抗、意志（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 意志（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: met the resistance that no applicant in the office would have noted
The resistance, meaning the opposition itself and not the stamp
Every sort of resistance in that office
the resistance at the far counter
the resistance was the whole of the matter
the resistance had become a line in a file
The resistance of the whole thing

answers.why: meet the resistance 意为“遇到这一股抵抗”，1957 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记下的一股抵抗做了一遍。
resistance 意为“抵抗；阻力”，指那股抵抗本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
resistance 意为“抵抗；阻力”，指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
resistance 意为“抵抗；阻力”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
resistance 意为“抵抗、意志”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这股意志就是那件事的全部。
resistance 意为“意志”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那股抵抗，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
resistance 意为“抵抗；阻力”，指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一股，到 1962 年这一股成了卷宗里的一行。
resistance 意为“抵抗之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的抵抗之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记下。
resistance 意为“抵抗；阻力”，我记得的是卷宗里记下过的那一股，1964 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一股。
resistance 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，抵抗是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的抵抗。
